title: Reverse Array
problem: Given an array of integers, return the array with its elements reversed.
intuition: Use two pointers, one starting from the beginning and one from the end. Swap their values and move both pointers toward the center.
approach: Initialize left to zero and right to the final index. While left is smaller than right, swap the elements and move both pointers.
algorithm: While left is less than right, swap nums[left] and nums[right].
solution: Use two pointers and swap elements from opposite ends.
code:
def solution(nums):
    left = 0
    right = len(nums) - 1

    while left < right:
        nums[left], nums[right] = nums[right], nums[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1

    return nums
